title: kstrail's free swimming is lost in a matched slow-inhibitor RD twin; a 5x slower inhibitor gives crawling crescents that jam
summary: Built rdtrail: kstrail with both taxis terms replaced by local threshold kinetics, keeping kstrail's a and h equations exactly. At kstrail's rates (kh 0.05) 3/3 seeds and 30 screened kinetic points give no travelling spots (stationary or self-replicating spots, max 1.5 BL) while kstrail on fresh seeds 3, 4 has 10/10 top tracks >= 5 BL. Slowing the inhibitor 2.5-5x gives kstrail-like crescents with trails, but they crawl at half speed and the replicating bodies jam (max 2.9 BL). One kinetic family, planted twin; see README limits.

finding.operator: self-repellent trail taxis (kstrail chi_h with chi_a cohesion, conserved rho)
finding.control: matched Laplacian-only twin: same a, h equations and Du, taxis replaced by threshold kinetics; plus inhibitor-time-scale scan kh 0.05/0.02/0.01
finding.result: kstrail seeds 3,4: moving tracks 23/25, top-10 >= 5 BL 10/10, speed 0.28-0.59. Twin kh0.05: moving 3/2/0, max BL 1.4/1.5/0.9, speed <= 0.17. kh0.02: max BL <= 2.4. kh0.01: crescents, max BL <= 2.9, speed <= 0.31; twin bodies self-replicate (gen 3-5) and jam.
